title: The Limits of Presidential Power
summary: American institutions face growing tests of their ability to restrain executive power, from immigration enforcement to military operations abroad. Constitutional checks, judicial oversight, and the limits of presidential authority remain central to preserving the rule of law.

title: Trump and the Courts: Who Holds the Power?
summary: The Trump administration has lost roughly 75% of emergency cases in lower courts while winning nearly 80% before the Supreme Court. That striking disparity raises questions about how the judiciary checks presidential power and maintains its independence under political pressure.
